bioavailability_ma.target_definition: oral bioavailability under the reported condition

clintox.target_definition: clinical-trial toxicity failure versus approved comparator

ames.target_definition: bacterial reverse mutation (Ames) under the reported condition

dili.target_definition: reported clinically meaningful human DILI outcome under the stated exposure and population; a negative is not universal absence of DILI risk

carcinogens.target_definition: Starling source-consensus carcinogenicity within one of five reported organism groups; sex, strain, route, dose and duration pooled, with original record restrictions preserved; no universal exposure claim
